The '''Ison Trade Corridor''', or simply the '''Ison Corridor''', was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that branched off from the major [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], passing through five [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] before reconnecting with the Spine further Rimward. Along the Ison Corridor sat, [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] to Rimward, the [[Varonat system/Legends|Varonat]], [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin]], [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat]], [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth]], and [[Ison system/Legends|Ison systems]].

The jumping-off points from the Corellian Trade Spine onto the Corridor were the planets [[Indellian]] (Coreward) and [[Mataou/Legends|Mataou]] (Rimward).

The Ison Corridor was widely seen as an obscure but dangerous backwater, and the systems in it largely devoid of potential. The corridor was also prone to ambushes by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Knowing that, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] decided to start [[Echo Base/Legends|their base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after the loss of the base at [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

On their way through, the remnants of [[Renegade Flight]] were [[Ison Corridor ambush|ambushed]] by Imperial forces inside a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].<ref name="RS II guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], along with the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], escorted a convoy of [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|transports]] through the Corridor.<ref name="RS II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Expandsect}}
The Ison Corridor was first mentioned in ''[[West End Games]]''{{'s}} ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''.

The location serves as a location for a Versus Mode match in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''.
